items.title: From baseline to Secure Software Factory: securing the systems that build your software
items.summary: In July, Docker, Snyk and Keycard published Agent Baseline, an open, vendor-neutral reference architecture that defines security outcomes for running AI agents in the enterprise. It grew out of conversations with industry leaders who want to adopt agents more broadly but need answers to three questions: What is operating, with what capabilities? Is it staying...
